column1: # kinds      begins: the words before, which eBible's file prints at the end of the verse before (after), begin the verse own; ends: the words before, which the file prints at the head of the verse own, end the verse before (after); words: the words before, as the file prints them and once in the verse, are those of after, read as the file's reader reads a line (the first keeps the paragraph break, the last the trailer)

# note       begins and ends: verse divisions of eBible's Brenton Greek (grcbrent) moved to where Brenton's own English, printed beside the same Greek with the same verse numbers, begins the verse, each only where a Greek edition begins it there too (drawn up 2026-09-28 against the files fetched 2026-09-02). why names the witnesses that begin the verse at exactly that word: BRENTON (Brenton's English, eBible eng-Brenton), GLAUX (the Greek Wikisource Septuagint GLAUx annotates), SWETE (Swete's own division), SWETE-BRACKETED (the English Bible's number Swete prints in brackets); for the one name neither Greek edition prints (Genesis 10:28), the Hebrew. words: where the file prints words twice or loses a clause between two that end alike, read as Brenton's English, Swete and GLAUx read the verse, in GLAUx's words
